name: LAZARUS GROUP CONTINUES APPLEJEUS OPERATION
description:
Telsy analyzed new samples related to the threat actor Lazarus Group and in particular to the 'AppleJeus Operation'.
While some of the details have changed, the methods used in the current scheme look very similar to how 'AppleJeus' worked previously. They both use legitimate cryptotrading applications and both have a secondary program which is the malware component. The hacker group released a trojanized version of the legitimate cryptotrading application “QtBitcoinTrader” even though unlike the previous operations the various stages of the infection all resided within the MSI package.
